0022600146.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, unbeaten at 4-0 on a four-game winning streak and 3-0 on the road, visit the Portland Trail Blazers, who are also unbeaten at 3-0 and 1-0 at home. Memphis is 2nd in the Southwest and 4th in the West, while Portland is 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 3rd in the West, with Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) both out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 122-114 defeat in Memphis on March 4, 2026.
